name: Grassy Plains
descriptions: Knee-high grass ripples in long waves across open country. The sky feels enormous here, broken only by a few drifting clouds.
A wide meadow spreads in every direction, dotted with clover and pale yellow wildflowers. Insects hum lazily in the warm air.
The land rises and falls in gentle swells of green. A faint game trail winds through the grass before vanishing again.
Wind hisses through the tall grass, bending it flat and letting it spring back. A lone boulder sits half-buried nearby.
Tufts of coarse grass grow between patches of bare, sun-baked earth. Somewhere far off a bird calls, and another answers.
Low hummocks of turf break up the plain here. Small burrows riddle the ground, and something darts out of sight as you pass.
A shallow dip in the grassland collects morning dew, leaving the stems here heavy and glistening.
The grass thins around a ring of flat stones, long ago arranged by someone and since forgotten.

lines: A breeze carries the smell of crushed grass.
Clouds cast slow shadows across the plain.
